tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the TAAFT directory for AI tools that match a query. Each result includes deal details when an approved TAAFT partner offer exists. Use url for TAAFT pages and website_url for external websites. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get public details for one TAAFT AI tool by slug, including deal details when an approved TAAFT partner offer exists. Use url for the TAAFT page and website_url for the external website. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: List or search TAAFT partner deals. Results use the same approved offers as the public deals page and include full tool details plus the TAAFT code, discount, plan, terms, trial, and expiry data when known.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Get one approved TAAFT partner deal by tool slug, including full tool details. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search TAAFT task categories for capabilities or jobs that users want AI tools to perform.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get public details for one TAAFT task category by slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search the TAAFT catalog for AI models by model name.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Get public details for one AI model by slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search and filter public TAAFT companies by name, description, industry, and products. Exact company names rank first.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get a public AI company profile, valuation, total raised, and paginated company-page collections by slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_robots
tools.description: Search and compare robots by name, description, specifications, type, use case, maker, and linked task. Supports hardware filters and sorting.

tools.name: get_robot
tools.description: Get public details and specifications for one robot by slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_devices
tools.description: Search and compare AI devices by name, description, specifications, type, use case, maker, and linked task. Supports hardware filters and sorting.

tools.name: get_device
tools.description: Get public details and specifications for one AI device by slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_organizations
tools.description: Search and browse AI organizations. Exact names, short names, and derived acronyms rank first. Filter by type, country, or industry, and sort by paper count or latest activity.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get public details, papers, and linked paper authors and companies for one AI organization by slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_investors
tools.description: Search or browse verified active investors in AI companies. Results include investor type, headquarters country, investment stages, and public fundraise count.

tools.name: get_investor
tools.description: Get public details and funding activity for one verified active AI investor by slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_countries
tools.description: Search TAAFT country pages for AI companies and activity by country.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: Get the public TAAFT country identity for a country code returned by search_countries. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search the TAAFT catalog for AI events by name.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get public details for one AI event by slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_fundraises
tools.description: Search and list public AI company fundraising rounds. Filter by company name, round type, announcement date, or participating investor slug, and sort by announcement date.

tools.name: get_fundraise
tools.description: Get public details and participating investors for one AI company fundraising round by ID. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search the TAAFT catalog for published AI research papers by title, optionally filtered by organization slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Get public details for one published AI research paper by ID or slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_repositories
tools.description: Search AI repositories by name, description, README, topics, owner, or linked TAAFT company. Results rank relevant, popular, official repositories first unless a sort is selected.

tools.name: get_repository
tools.description: Get public details for one AI repository by its owner/repository slug or numeric ID. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_mcps
tools.description: Search and recommend MCP servers by name, description, capabilities, protocol tools, company, task, and category. The query is optional; use filters or sort to browse the directory.

tools.name: get_mcp
tools.description: Get public details for one MCP server by slug. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search public AI news by keyword, time frame, topic, source, and importance. An omitted or empty query lists matching items.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Get one public AI news item by ID.

tools.name: search_breakthroughs
tools.description: Search public AI breakthroughs by keyword, time frame, topic, source, and importance. An omitted or empty query lists matching items.

tools.name: get_breakthrough
tools.description: Get one public AI breakthrough by ID.

tools.name: list_features
tools.description: List every TAAFT feature with its id, name, slug, TAAFT URL, tool count, and model count. This is a complete alphabetical listing, not a search: there is no query and no relevance ranking. Call it with no arguments to list everything. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

tools.name: list_feature_tools
tools.description: List every AI tool on one TAAFT feature, in the same order as the feature page. This is a complete listing, not a search: no query, no relevance ranking, nothing missing and nothing extra. Each tool carries the full get_tool fields, including deal details when an approved TAAFT partner offer exists.

tools.name: list_feature_models
tools.description: List every AI model on one TAAFT feature, in the same order as the feature page. This is a complete listing, not a search: no query, no relevance ranking, nothing missing and nothing extra. Each model carries the full get_model fields. Preserve returned URLs exactly.
